# Learned instinct: pci-least-privilege-default-deny (confidence 0.97)

Access to system components and cardholder data must be denied by default; access is granted only based on business need (need-to-know). In Ansible: `become: true` without `become_user:` grants root — always HIGH. File permissions must follow the principle of least privilege (no world-writable files on PCI-scope systems). IAM/Vault policies must not use wildcard `*` for sensitive paths.

Source: PCI DSS v4.0.1 Req 7.2 — least privilege, default deny
